kind.description: inspect investigates; candidate submits work for actual acceptance. blocked reports an unverified obstacle and receives rework feedback; it cannot pause or complete the task.

op.description: read: known original ranges; search: locate evidence through RAG; shell: editing, execution and runtime diagnostics, never evidence search.

path.description: Authorized repository scope, $record path or host-registered $container namespace. Never widen the registered scope.

query.description: Search: one complete case-sensitive literal string. Read: empty normally; 'reread: <reason>' requests a deliberate verbatim recheck. For oversized tool payloads, copy the returned next_query (payload_bytes:<byte offset>) here with offset=0 and limit=2000; follow its byte continuation, not a guessed line offset. Search text appears once in results; hits[].result and results[].source are zero-based indexes into results and sources.

limit.description: read: default 2000, range 1..2000. Other operations: default 80, maximum 1000.

mode.description: One case-sensitive literal substring query. Preserve whitespace and repeated text; BM25 ranks matching files automatically.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from search or read; empty for an initial request.

from_step.description: Read only: an earlier search step id in this plan. Up to five matched ranges share the same 50 KiB text budget; changed source versions require a new search.

command.description: Shell code for editing, execution or runtime diagnostics; do not search existing source, documents or saved logs here.

test_code.description: Complete Python unittest source with actual newline characters. Do not wrap the entire test module in exec/eval of an encoded string: test attribution must retain real source locations. The test file is outside the project; locate the real repository from cwd, not from the test file __file__.

test_driver.description: Repository Python test entry or -m module plus argv, without a Python executable. Include {test_file} or {test_module}; reuse the repository configuration/fixtures. [] uses the builtin unittest collector for a new draft, or reuses a frozen driver.

execution_checks.description: Required for first generated acceptance: artifact type, real entry and consuming runtime. [] only for inspection, fixed user commands, or reuse of frozen checks. Compile/syntax-check and execute the actual artifact. Wine CMD instead parses and executes the unchanged BAT/CMD once; only exercised paths are validated in compatibility mode. Invocation-only call and unchecked executable consumers are not supported. Python APIs and file artifacts use python_tests: bind Class.test_method IDs in test_code. Call the original synchronous Python function/method in those tests, or read delivered bytes with acceptance_artifacts.read_artifact(relative_path) and validate them. The existing test execution supplies the receipt; do not add a substitute CLI or rerun it. No task-name detection or self-reported pass.

requirement_quote.description: Verbatim original requirement scope; empty binds the complete original request.

python_module.description: Optional dotted module for Python -m; entry_file must be its module .py or package __main__.py. Empty executes the original file.

api_entry.description: For python_api only: the original module:function or module:Class.method actually called by the bound unittest methods.

test_ids.description: For python_tests only: Class.test_method IDs in test_code. Each must actually call the API or read the original artifact through acceptance_artifacts.read_artifact(relative_path). No second execution is performed.
